# GatGrid Cruises

> GatGrid Cruises is a Disney Cruise Line concierge and booking service run by Dr. Grayson Starbuck, DPT, as an independent travel advisor through Boardwalk Travel Agency (CLIA 00039054, FL Seller of Travel ST43802). Booking help is 100% free to the traveler — the cruise line pays the commission — and clients who book through GatGrid receive free onboard credit as a booking incentive. GatGrid is an independent resource and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to The Walt Disney Company or Disney Cruise Line.

## What GatGrid helps with
- Free, personalized Disney Cruise Line quotes and booking (all ships, itineraries, and stateroom categories)
- Free onboard credit (OBC) on bookings made through Boardwalk Travel Agency, scaled to cruise fare
- Price-drop monitoring after booking, so clients can be rebooked at lower fares when eligible
- Concierge planning: dining, staterooms, ports, onboard activity booking windows by Castaway Club tier
- Transferring an existing Disney Cruise reservation to GatGrid (where eligible) for added perks
- Group sailings and first-timer guidance

## Key pages
- [Get a free quote](https://gatgridcruises.com/book): Start a free, no-obligation Disney cruise quote; a licensed specialist follows up, usually same day.
- [How onboard credit works](https://gatgridcruises.com/onboard-credit): What OBC is and how GatGrid clients earn it.
- [OBC calculator](https://gatgridcruises.com/tools/obc-calculator): Estimate onboard credit from an expected cruise fare.
- [Ships](https://gatgridcruises.com/ships): Guides to every Disney Cruise Line ship.
- [Deal grid](https://gatgridcruises.com/deals): Current Disney cruise sailings and deal scores.
- [Guides](https://gatgridcruises.com/guides): Packing lists, travel insurance, port guides, and planning help.
- [Transfer an existing booking](https://gatgridcruises.com/transfer): Move an eligible Disney reservation to GatGrid.
- [Group sailings](https://gatgridcruises.com/group-cruise): Planning for multi-stateroom and group trips.
- [Giving back](https://gatgridcruises.com/giving-back): GatGrid donates a share of commission to CURE International.
- [About](https://gatgridcruises.com/about): About Dr. Grayson Starbuck and the service.
- [Contact](https://gatgridcruises.com/contact): How to reach GatGrid Cruises.

## Good to know
- Service area: United States (nationwide); planning is done remotely by phone, text, and email.
- Cost: free to the traveler for booking and concierge service.
- Onboard credit is applied after final payment and is subject to change based on the compensation received; it is not guaranteed and has no cash value.
- Always confirm current prices, itineraries, and policies directly with Disney Cruise Line before booking.
